test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can do as much work as B and C together can do. A and B can together do a piece of work in 7 hours 12 minutes and C can do it in 36 hours. Find the time (in hours) that B needs to do the work alone.
solution:
__Given:__ 

The efficiency of A = Efficiency of B and C together

Time taken by A and B to complete = 7 hours 12 minutes = 7.2 hours

Time taken by C to complete = 36 hours 

__Concept Used:__

The time required to complete the work is the reciprocal of the fraction of work done in one time period (one hour).

__Solution:__

(A + B)'s one hour work = (1)/(7.2)

C's one hour work = (1)/(36)

(A + B + C)'s one hour work = (1)/(7.2)+(1)/(36)=(12)/(72) = frac16

replace B + C with A as the efficiency of both is the same

(2A)'s one hour work = frac16

A's one hour work = (1)/(12)

B's one hour work = (1)/(7.2)-(1)/(12)=(1)/(18)

**Therefore time taken by B to complete the whole work = 18 hours**
